codex_independent_judgment.rationale: The exact immediate resize/focus/Space sequence reproduced two misses in 20 attempts. In both traces resize replaces the focused tile DOM between Space keydown and keyup; no native click follows keyup, so the engine never receives a tile click. This is the driver firing keyboard input before viewport event processing settles. Twenty two-RAF-settled resize cases and ten steady Enter/Space cases all work with the same published artifact. A pending resize cancelling an in-progress native activation is not a persistent blocked input or unintended tile removal. The original first failure had no trace; this records a reproduced mechanism, not a claim to have captured its historical event sequence.

actual_next_action.description: Added read-only event/resize/DOM replacement tracing in a fresh public browser context; reproduced exact raw sequence 2/20, contrasted settled resize 20/20 and steady Enter/Space 10/10. Denied consent, blocked every non-site request, made no game-data writes or product changes.
